scope: E11 unified ablation, E12 mean/subspace factorial and head data efficiency, E14 analysis of existing boundary/interior results; exploratory existing data
feature_cache: runs/stride1_seed42, local RTX PRO 6000 CUDA extraction; edit dense source then sample output stride2
historical: fold0 only, strict-v1 excludes R02 testing12/13/14; no assumption that all historical faults are appearance faults
tracker: Frozen E9S PhysicalTracker per fold/seed; same tracker and framewise appearance models shared by all E11 arms; refit every score calibration from current normal reference computations

E11.A: max(pooled outside, pooled inside, local), components calibrated on reference
E11.C: uniform Fourier mean and one shared residual PCA, no confidence gate; max reference-calibrated outside and inside scores
E11.P: max(reference-calibrated alignment, innovation, progress), fixed P4 composition

mean_selection.criterion: seed42 per-fold mean per-video normal-validation reconstruction MSE; freeze chosen hyperparameters across seeds

E11.calibration: E9S video-equal weighted normal D-window maxima; quantiles [.90,.95,.975,.99,.995], primary .99; frame-q99 secondary
E11.windows: Same E9S T,D,W,onsets and 3910 eligible edits; no edit map or future indices enter temporal model
E11.overlap: Compare B1 vs P at each arm's own primary threshold, then report actual B3 gains/losses relative to B1,B2 and their conceptual union; no assumption max-fusion preserves the union after recalibration
E11.historical_events: contiguous positive intervals per source, deadline min(interval length,D); unknown intervals excluded; save full-interval coverage separately
E11.checks: C branch causal prefix and edit identity; score-level max dominance, not alarm-set dominance; reference/threshold disjoint from evaluation

arms.S5: continuous mean + squared residual norm, no PCA

E12.subsets: nested FIT-only source subsets, ceil(fraction*n_fit) with minimum2; source hash order from seed and identity; tracker and A use full FIT and stay fixed, so this is head sample efficiency, NOT whole-system few-shot
E12.mean_hyperparameters: frozen E11 seed42 validation selection, same for every mean/subspace condition and fraction; no retuning on historical faults
E12.sampling: same video-balanced sampled rows for all arms in a subset, capped4096; bin PCA partitions these same rows
E12.rank: exact common total R = 8*floor(min(64,d-1,n-2,4*(minimum4bin_count-2),8*(minimum8bin_count-2))/8); shared R versus per-bin R/K; disable variance truncation
E12.coverage: if R<8 or any bin has fewer than2 distinct FIT source videos, PCA family unavailable for that subset; record coverage and never silently substitute or pool unmatched units
E12.calibration: all components use global normal reference tails; per-arm normal frame-q99 primary and window-q99 secondary; phase-conditioned calibration is reserved for E15
metrics: normal mu MSE and outside MSE
batch1 head score latency, not end-to-end latency
E12.memory_scope: Report measured storage-performance frontier; total rank equality does not imply equal bytes. Do not claim exact byte-matched comparison.

E14.input: existing E9S all3seeds stride2 plus stride1seed42
E14.analysis: initial32-frame hits and valid edited-interior hits; compare with exactly matched original windows, source-equal within scene/type/severity
E14.limits: interior retains boundary-altered filter state; skip has no sustained interior; unavailable interiors reported, never treated as misses; recovery and jump-matched controls remain later experiments

uncertainty.unit: source video within scene, paired; derivatives and nested fractions stay clustered
uncertainty.scope: primary seed42 model-conditional intervals; other seeds point robustness; no multiplicity-adjusted significance or recording-independence claim

publication: each completed stage gets code/config/numeric artifacts/validation/README tables and SVG figures; unavailable annotations and later stages retain explicit pending status
remaining_stages: E13 process alternatives and stop diagnosis
final E11 rerun after any model changes
